summary.id: Sekar naik ke kapal Pak Karta Senin malem. Seseorang menelepon tanpa suara, dan tombol perekamnya berbunyi dua kali.
summary.en: Sekar went to Pak Karta's boat on Monday night. Someone called without a word, and a recorder button clicked twice.
